tool.name: Webatlas Generate image
tool.command: #if $input_type_selector == "label_visium": #if $file_type_selector_visium == "h5ad": ln -s '$input_visium_h5ad' input.h5ad && python "${__tool_directory__}/generate_image.py" --stem $stem --img_type label --file_type visium --file_path input.h5ad @VISIUM_LABEL_COMMAND@ mv $stem-label.tif $output_label #elif $file_type_selector_visium == "zip": mkdir unpacked_spaceranger && unzip $input_visium_zip -d unpacked_spaceranger && python "${__tool_directory__}/generate_image.py" --stem $stem --img_type label --file_type visium --file_path unpacked_spaceranger @VISIUM_LABEL_COMMAND@ mv $stem-label.tif $output_label #end if #elif $input_type_selector == "label_xenium": mkdir unpacked_xenium && unzip $input_xenium -d unpacked_xenium && python "${__tool_directory__}/generate_image.py" --stem $stem --img_type label --file_type xenium --file_path unpacked_xenium && mv $stem-label.tif $output_label #elif $input_type_selector == "label_merscope": mkdir unpacked_merscope && unzip $input_merscope_label -d unpacked_merscope && python "${__tool_directory__}/generate_image.py" --stem $stem --img_type label --file_type merscope --file_path unpacked_merscope && mv $stem-label.tif $output_label #elif $input_type_selector == "raw_merscope": mkdir unpacked_merscope && unzip $input_merscope_label -d unpacked_merscope && python "${__tool_directory__}/generate_image.py" --stem $stem --img_type raw --file_type merscope --file_path unpacked_merscope && mv $stem-raw.tif $output_raw #end if

param.name: input_type_selector
param.label: Choose the type of input data
param.option: Merscope data with raw tif files

param.name: file_type_selector_visium
param.label: Choose the type of input file

param.name: sample_id
param.label: Sample ID
param.help: Sample ID string within the AnnData object.

param.name: relative_size
param.label: Relative size
param.help: Optional numerical 'obs' column name that holds a multiplier for the spot diameter. Only useful for data that has been processed to merge spots.

param.name: input_xenium
param.label: zip compressed Xenium output or cells.zarr.zip file
